verdict.why: The Right build has a coherent massing (one two-storey brick box with a continuous stone plinth, a clean gable and a chimney) and regular window and door rhythm, so it reads as a finished house; the Left build has ragged, patchy walls with random roof blocks, dark-stone and copper blotches, and holes in the wall, so it reads as a damaged or unfinished structure that would look out of place on a street.
